fact: NIMC's MobileID app, launched in December 2021, had 17,428,562 downloads and 67,717,205 verifications (67,180,743 enterprise) as at 27 April 2023, with tokenized virtual NINs issued to enterprises for authentication.
title: The NIMC MOBILE APP: Changing the game of Digital Identity Management
publisher: National Identity Management Commission (ID4Africa AGM presentation)
